name: Wonik Pne Co., Ltd.
summary: Wonik Pne Co., Ltd. is a South Korean company that develops and supplies automated equipment for rechargeable battery production and laser-assisted manufacturing. Their product portfolio features packaging and degasification machines, as well as laser slitting and cutting systems. These offerings are instrumental in the creation of rechargeable batteries and optical films. Established in 1999, the firm, previously known as NS Co., Ltd., maintains its headquarters in Cheongju, South Korea.
